jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (all levels)
jobs.description:
Skyflow secures the flow of data across datastores, models, and agents. Enterprises turn to Skyflow as their runtime AI data control layer to protect sensitive data, enable safe AI deployment, and unlock full value from their applications, data platforms, and AI systems. 

Skyflow is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, and leading SaaS companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality.



Skyflow is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and was founded in 2019. For more information, visit www.skyflow.com http://www.skyflow.com or follow on X https://twitter.com/SkyflowAPI and LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/skyflow/.

 

About the role

Skyflow's product marketing team are storytellers. We're highly collaborative, deeply empathetic to our customers, and we work cross-functionally across nearly every part of the company. This role owns the narrative for a category-defining, infrastructure-level product where the buyer is technical, skeptical, and high-stakes.



You'll translate what Skyflow does at an architectural level into a story that both engineers and executives can act on, and you'll carry that story through launch, enablement, content, and pipeline. This role reports into Marketing leadership and partners closely with Product, Sales, and Demand Gen.





What you'll do:



Own the narrative. Turn Skyflow's AI data control and tokenization capabilities into a clear, credible story for technical and business audiences. Close the "why should I care" gap in every sales and marketing touchpoint, whether the reader is an architect or a CFO.

Run launches end to end. When Product ships, align Product, Sales, and Marketing on one story and one rollout plan. Own the website, content, collateral, and funnel assets that turn a launch into real adoption instead of a launch that fizzles.

Enable Sales to win technical deals. Build the battlecards, training, demo content, and objection-handling materials that give reps the credibility to close skeptical enterprise technical buyers. This means genuinely understanding the systems and architectures Skyflow operates across.

Produce content that moves deals. Map content to where a prospect actually is in a long, technical consideration cycle. Account for their stage, their background, and the context a seller needs to advance the deal, so prospects keep moving instead of going dark.

Partner on pipeline. Work directly with Demand Gen and BDR teams on messaging that converts interest into qualified opportunities in target accounts. Build the feedback loop between teams that lifts close rates over time and keeps pipeline healthy and predictable, not just high-volume.





You have:



 - Led product marketing where the primary buyer is deeply technical (architects, engineering leaders, security teams), requiring precise, trust-building narratives

 - Crafted messaging for complex, infrastructure-level or API-first products, translating deep technical capability into clear, differentiated value for enterprise buyers

 - Run cross-functional launches with Product, Sales, and Marketing, and can point to adoption you drove, not just assets you shipped

 - Built sales enablement (battlecards, demos, objection handling) for high-stakes enterprise deals, and can speak credibly to how technical systems fit together

 - Produced stage-matched content across a long enterprise buying cycle and know what actually moves a deal forward

 - Partnered with Demand Gen and BDR on messaging that converts, with a track record of feedback loops that improved close rates

 - Comfort operating at any altitude, from the strategic narrative down to the specific asset a rep needs on a Tuesday
   
   
   
   
   
   Benefits:

 - Work from home expense (U.S., Canada, and Australia)

 - Excellent Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance Options (Varies by Country)

 - Vanguard 401k

 - Flexible Paid Time Off (Unlimited)

 - Generous Equity
   



At Skyflow, we believe that diverse teams are the strongest teams. We invite applicants of all genders, races, ethnicities, nationalities, ages, religions, sexual orientations, disability statuses, educational experiences, family situations, and socio-economic backgrounds.

jobs.title: AI Product Lead
jobs.description:
Skyflow secures the flow of data across datastores, models, and agents. Enterprises turn to Skyflow as their runtime AI data control layer to protect sensitive data, enable safe AI deployment, and unlock full value from their applications, data platforms, and AI systems. 

Skyflow is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, and leading SaaS companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality.



Skyflow is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and was founded in 2019. For more information, visit www.skyflow.com http://www.skyflow.com or follow on X https://twitter.com/SkyflowAPI and LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/skyflow/.

 




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Secure Data Flows s is at the heart of Skyflow’s integration strategy. It defines how customers connect Skyflow to the rest of their ecosystem—through APIs, batch pipelines, webhooks, triggers, and event-based notifications. It’s how we make data protection effortless for developers, while keeping compliance airtight.

As the Product Manager for Secure Workflows, you’ll own the vision, strategy, and execution for this critical product area. You’ll help define how developers and partners interact with Skyflow, and ensure every data movement is secure, compliant, and beautifully simple.






WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Lead the vision and roadmap for Secure Data Flows, shaping the way customers integrate with Skyflow especially across their Agentic AI architectures and workflow

 - Collaborate closely with engineering and design to build scalable, reliable features that power data movement at global scale.

 - Enable first-class support for unstructured data flowing into AI workflows, AI and agent-native workflows in close partnership with adjacent product areas.

 - Partner with customers and technology partners to expand Skyflow’s ecosystem and build frictionless integrated experiences.

 - Translate Skyflow’s privacy mission into a cohesive product strategy turning customer insights, feedback, and data into clear execution plans.

 - Work cross-functionally to drive outcomes, prioritize effectively, and bring clarity in an evolving, fast-paced environment.

 - Define success metrics and iterate relentlessly to improve developer experience and platform adoption.

 - Partner closely with engineering and design to deliver scalable, reliable, enterprise-grade workflow orchestration (e.g., triggers, conditional execution, containerized steps, simplified connections).

 - Work with customers, ISVs, and technology partners to validate real-world workflows and ensure extensibility across ecosystems.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions, CX, and GTM teams to ensure workflows are operable, supportable, and adoptable at scale.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING



 - 3+ years of technical product management experience, ideally in developer-facing, integration or platform products.

 - 2+ years of experience working on SaaS platforms in security, privacy, or data infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with AI or agent-based systems (e.g., tool invocation, orchestration, MCP-style patterns)  you don’t need to be an ML expert, but you understand how AI systems operate in production

 - Experience collaborating with partners and customers to design scalable solutions.
   Strong communication skills you can explain complex systems in simple, human terms.

 - A bias for action, with the ability to execute and adapt in an ambiguous environment.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and making progress in fast-evolving technical domains.






BENEFITS



 - Work from home expense (U.S., Canada, and Australia)

 - Excellent Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance Options (Varies by Country)

 - Vanguard 401k

 - Flexible Paid Time Off (Unlimited)

 - Generous Equity
